hooks.command: tmux set-option -p -q -o -t "$TMUX_PANE" @claude_idle_since "$(date +%s)" \; set-option -p -t "$TMUX_PANE" @status idle \; wait-for -S state-changed
tmux set-option -p -u -t "$TMUX_PANE" @claude_idle_since \; set-option -p -t "$TMUX_PANE" @status running \; wait-for -S state-changed
tmux set-option -p -u -t "$TMUX_PANE" @claude_idle_since \; set-option -p -t "$TMUX_PANE" @status running \; wait-for -S state-changed

if jq -e '.background_tasks | length > 0' >/dev/null; then tmux set-option -p -u -t "$TMUX_PANE" @claude_idle_since \; set-option -p -t "$TMUX_PANE" @status running \; wait-for -S state-changed; else tmux set-option -p -q -o -t "$TMUX_PANE" @claude_idle_since "$(date +%s)" \; set-option -p -t "$TMUX_PANE" @status idle \; wait-for -S state-changed; fi
tmux set-option -p -q -o -t "$TMUX_PANE" @claude_idle_since "$(date +%s)" \; set-option -p -t "$TMUX_PANE" @status idle \; wait-for -S state-changed
